title: Compute brief - 21 October 2026
description: A blocked power line cost NextDC about 42% of its market value: Jemena suspended works for M3 Melbourne, FY27 guidance was cut and all uncontracted development paused. NVIDIA used GTC Berlin to fund substrate, packaging and test capacity and to pitch 14-day factory-built AI factories. Tape: 68 confirms, 2 ticks (Crusoe H100 and H200 back down), 0 NEW; Crusoe B200 on-demand now Contact sales.
og_kicker: A suspended 66 kV line wipes A$3 billion off NextDC
lede: The grid risk that the market has been pricing in the abstract arrived on a single balance sheet. NextDC came out of its trading halt on 21 October saying Jemena has suspended parts of the 66 kV works needed for the next power step-up at M3 Melbourne because of community opposition and missing council consent, and will not restart before February 2027. NextDC pulled about A$140 million of M3 revenue and EBITDA out of FY27 guidance, cut capex by A$750 million, put every new development and land purchase on hold and warned that its customer has service credit and, in some cases, termination rights. Reuters says the shares closed down 41.7%, the worst day since the 2010 listing. On the supply side, NVIDIA used GTC Berlin to announce funded capacity in substrates (2.5x over three years), Amkor interposers (more than 300% by end 2028), testing (a $1.1 billion advance to KYEC for US sites) and co-packaged optics, plus DSX POD containers that it says cut on-site deployment from six months to as little as 14 days. Capital is still finding powered sites: Humain and DataVolt named Nebius as the first anchor for up to 50 MW at Oxagon in NEOM, while Anthropic's second Monarch building with Nscale remains unsigned. On the public tape, Crusoe reversed its 16 October increases (H100 $4.50 to $3.90, H200 $5.40 to $4.29) and moved B200 on-demand from $8.50 to Contact sales; 68 other prints confirmed across all six venues.

countries.name: Australia
countries.note: NextDC: Jemena suspended 66 kV works for M3 Melbourne (restart not before Feb 2027); next supply step now FY28; FY27 net revenue guidance A$475 to 500 million from A$615 to 640 million; capex cut to A$4.5 to 5.0 billion; all new development and land purchases on hold; shares down 41.7% (Wire, 21 Oct).

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: Humain and DataVolt preliminary framework with Nebius for up to 50 MW of the first 100 MW under construction at Oxagon, NEOM (planned 360 MW phase one), phased from Q4 2027 (Wire, 21 Oct).

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Wisconsin DNR settlement keeps Vantage Port Washington permits valid but commits to a statewide Data Center Strategic Analysis by 31 Jan 2028, paid for by Vantage (Wire, 19 Oct). NVIDIA advances $1.1 billion to KYEC for US chip test facilities, high-volume production targeted April 2027 (Signal).
